mapper.select: select p.id, p.post_name, p.dept_id, d.dept_name, p.base_salary from post p left join dept d on p.dept_id = d.id where p.id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into post(post_name, dept_id, base_salary) values(#{postName}, #{deptId}, #{baseSalary})
INSERT INTO post(post_name, dept_id, base_salary) VALUES(#{postName}, #{deptId}, #{baseSalary})
